headline.description: One sentence: the most important thing this run found, or that nothing needs attention.

digest.description: Markdown, at most 300 words. What changed in the outside world and on the servers, in prose and short bullets. Do not list the findings here; the publisher appends them with links.

key.description: Stable slug naming the underlying problem, not this week's symptom, so a later run produces the same key.

title.description: Issue title, under 80 characters, stating the defect or gap.

confidence.description: confirmed: you read the tessera code and the problem is there. likely: the evidence points to it. unverified: worth a look, not checked.

body.description: Markdown issue body with the sections What, Evidence, Where in tessera, Suggested fix, How to verify.

existing_issue.description: Number of an existing issue that already covers this, or null.

comment.description: Only with existing_issue: new evidence to add as a comment, or null when there is nothing new.

watching.description: Short one-line notes on developments that need no action yet (a proposal entering review, a discussion to follow).
